Title: Time question.   chiropteran marauder / Steal Blood / Rotschreck

Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
I could not find an answer to this, but I'm not the google guru, so I'll ask 
again!\

Minion A  and B are in combat
minion B has 2 blood.

Is A steals 2 blood, can B still play a Superior  chiropteran marauder and 
Rotschrek?

I'm thinking no, but I've been wrong before

Raille

Well, I'm not a rules guru by any means, but I think it's:

Neither strike resolves, since combat ends via rotschreck. Minion B
can burn 1 to pay for superior chiropteran, since thats required for
striking with agg (and incidentally could even WITHOUT rotscheck,
since you choose strike, pay, then resolve - so B would still aggpoke,
and A could only steal 1) playing rotty means that A never gets to
steal anything, and enjoys naptime.
